name: test_edit_generated_table_canvas_open_and_verify_display
description:
Generate a table via chat, open its edit canvas, and verify the
        full editable-grid display (columns, rows, checkboxes, pagination,
        download button).

        Steps (AFS
        test-specs/chat-interface/l3_edit-generated-table-canvas-open-and-verify-display_ELITEA-2086.md):
        1. Navigate to Chats and open a conversation.
        2. Send "generate a table of top 10 IT companies".
        3. Verify the rendered table's columns.
        4. Verify the rendered table's company data.
        5. Locate the pencil/edit icon.
        6. Click it; verify the canvas opens with heading "Edit table" and
           the conversation pane shows the editing indicator.
        7. Verify the editable DataGrid shows all columns/rows.
        8. Verify sortable column headers.
        9. Verify row checkboxes.
        10. Verify pagination "1-10 of 10" / "Rows per page: 50".
        11. Verify the "Download as xlsx" button.

steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to Chats and open a conversation
Step 2 — Send "generate a table of top 10 IT companies"; verify a table is generated
Step 3 — Verify the table shows a stable core column set (Rank, Company, a headquarters-type column, a business/focus column) — column SET is AI-generated, not fixed
Step 4 — Verify the table shows 10 rows of company data including the confirmed-stable core companies (set membership, not fixed row order/index)
Step 5 — Locate the pencil/edit icon in the table toolbar
Step 6 — Click the pencil/edit icon; verify the canvas opens with heading "Edit table" and the conversation pane shows the editing indicator
Step 7 — Verify the canvas displays the table as an editable DataGrid with all columns and rows from step 3/4
Step 8 — Verify sortable column headers are present for every column (via stable data-field attribute, per AFS header-text extraction caveat)
Step 9 — Verify row checkboxes appear on the left, one per row
Step 10 — Verify pagination shows "1-10 of 10" and "Rows per page: 50"
Step 11 — Verify a "Download as xlsx" button appears
Side-channel — verify no unexpected console errors occurred across the whole flow (known secrets-403 noise is pre-filtered)
